messages.text: git revert 9f3c1a: restored the previous retry policy after the 502 spike on the payments gateway. The revert applied cleanly on main and the branch builds. The change had raised the retry count from 2 to 5 without an idempotency key, which is the suspected cause of the duplicate charges reported on Tuesday.

Reverted the retry change to stop the 502 spike. The duplicate-charge bug is still open: the revert does not add idempotency keys, so the root cause remains until those are added in a follow-up. I have not verified that the duplicates stopped; the support queue will tell us over the next day.
